gap: No result ChatGPT got states that the Galaxy Watch8's ECG and blood-pressure app (Samsung Health Monitor) works only when the watch is paired with a Samsung phone running Android 12 or later, and only in a country where Samsung has released the app. So 'Android smartwatch' and 'works with your Android phone' are different things.
standout_why: I compared against the two cited pages and two top results. The cited pages are the Google Store Charge 6 specs, which I couldn't read because WebFetch returned a truncated page, and Apple's Series 11 tech specs (support.apple.com/en-mide/125093), which covers only iPhone and iOS needs. itechguides.com rank 15 gives Charge 6 at Android 9 / iOS 15 and Apple at iPhone 11 / iOS 26, and says nothing on Galaxy Watch, Pixel Watch or Garmin. sekin.in rank 14 gives Charge 6 at Android 11 / iOS 16.4 and says Android-paired trackers have preset quick replies, but it names no iPhone model for Apple. None of them say that a Samsung watch's health features need a Samsung phone. None say that Garmin's on-watch text replies are Android-only, or that Pixel Watch 4 excludes Android Go phones. Phone-OS minimums for Fitbit and Apple are already covered by rivals, which is why this scores 2 and not 3.
decides: It splits the smartwatch pick by phone. With an iPhone, take the Apple Watch SE 3: iPhone 11 or later, and Apple's own page now gives both iOS 26 and iOS 27. With a Samsung Galaxy phone, the Galaxy Watch8 gets its full ECG and blood-pressure features. With any other Android phone, the Pixel Watch 4 is the safer full smartwatch, needing Android 11 or later and not an Android Go phone, since the Galaxy Watch8 loses its Samsung Health Monitor features there. If you want to reply to texts from the wrist, Garmin vívoactive 6 replies only work on Android, so for iPhone owners it is a notifications-only watch. That keeps the 'fitness tracker or watch' answer tied to the phone, which ChatGPT only asked about without explaining what changes.

findings.label: Phone needed for Samsung Health Monitor (ECG, blood pressure)
findings.value: Samsung phone running Android 12.0 or higher; blood pressure needs a cuff calibration every 28 days; must be used in a country where the app is released
findings.source_title: Use the Samsung Health Monitor app on your Galaxy watch
findings.note: Quoted: 'Samsung phone operating Android OS 12.0 or higher'; 'Requires initial and periodic calibrations every 28 days'; 'You must use the app and its features in a country where Samsung Health Monitor has been released.' The page lists Galaxy Watch Active2 or newer, so it covers Watch8. It does not say the watch can't pair with an iPhone, so we don't claim that.
